components.name: Finite task-refinement lattice and minimal repair multiplicity
components.project_addition: Lift the existing P023 coarsest pair-repair theorem to an exact finite counting calculus. Query-language union becomes equivalence-relation intersection; combined quotient size is the number of realized quotient-label tuples rather than the full Cartesian-product candidate count; and the minimum repair alphabet from a coarse task partition E to a finer target F is the maximum number of F-blocks contained in any one E-block. Repair cost is submultiplicative along refinement chains. General partition-lattice, kernel-intersection and closure-system facts are established mathematics; historical novelty of the project packaging and applications is unverified.
